title: Seagrove "Our Southern Charm" 701 Eastern Lake Road Upper Level
h1: Seagrove "Our Southern Charm" 701 Eastern Lake Road Upper Level
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf-front- Private beach access- Complimentary beach setups each morning includes 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella (Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31)- Professionally Decorated- 3 Adult Bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Enjoy the coastal elegance and beachfront luxury of "Our Southern Charm!" The upper level of this gorgeous, gulf-facing home offers 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a spacious loft, stunning interiors, private beach access, breathtaking panoramic Emerald Coast views, and incredible accommodations for 10 guests!Guests staying in this home's upper level are welcomed with a jewel-toned ocean view, lots of natural light, and soft, neutral decor elements. The open layout seamlessly connects the main living, dining, and kitchen areas. Professionally decorated interiors create a warm and inviting ambiance and set the stage for a relaxing getaway. The living room's plush furnishings make the perfect place to sink down in front of the mounted flat-screen television. Bright white cabinets and a white tile backsplash amplify the natural light in the gorgeous kitchen. The chefs in your group will undoubtedly love preparing fresh, coastal meals in this space, which offers top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, a beautiful farmhouse sink, and lots of countertop space. The breakfast bar creates the perfect place for others to gather over appetizers and entertain the cooks as they work. Guests can enjoy 3 seats at the breakfast bar and 6 additional seats at the adjacent dining table. Sliding glass doors lead to the spacious second-floor back deck, which provides a place to enjoy the rejuvenating beach views with a morning coffee or a favorite evening cocktail.This level also boasts 3 beautiful bedrooms with a variety of sleeping arrangements. The first offers a cozy queen bed and a private bathroom with a shower. Guests can also choose between 2 king bed guest rooms, both utilizing a shared bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The final guest room area is the spacious and airy loft, which features 4 twin beds, 4 plush chairs, a flat-screen television, and a private bathroom with a shower.This home's prime location right on the beach allows your family to enjoy the sugar-white sand and sparkling emerald waters from sunrise to sunset. Enjoy dinners al fresco on the home's porches while waves provide the background music. Three custom 360 Blue adult beach cruiser bikes offer the perfect way to explore Seagrove and all of the incredible local dining, shopping, and entertainment options in our amazing 30A coastal towns. Book today to experience the upper level of "Our Southern Charm!"SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSSECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR- Loft Area: Four Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyParties, weddings or events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing by 360 Blue. Fees apply. Contact us for additional details.
